variables.name: WEBFINGER_DOMAIN
variables.description: Public domain name that serves the WebFinger endpoint. It has to match the domain part of the email addresses of your users.

variables.name: WEBFINGER_ISSUER
variables.description: The OIDC issuer URL that is advertised by the WebFinger endpoint. It has to match the issuer in the /.well-known/openid-configuration of the provider exactly.
